page.overview:
Who is Graham?

Graham was a dentist in Haddonfield that temporarily acted as a medical examiner. He examined the burned corpse of Bennett Tramer, whom Deputy Gary Hunt and Doctor Samuel Loomis mistakenly believed to be serial killer Michael Myers. The coroner, Roland Baker, was unable to identify the body due to the nature of Tramer's death; the body was burned beyond recognition, and thus Loomis requested a dentist to be present to compare the body's teeth to Michael's dental records.
